---
title: "Homework 7"
---

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
data(iris)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
# Question 1
str(iris)
# There are 150 observations and 5 variables

# Question 2
iris1 <- filter(iris, Species != "setosa" & Sepal.Length>6 & Sepal.Width>2.5)
str(iris1)
# There are 56 observations and 5 variables

# Question 3
iris2 <- select(iris1, Species, Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width)
str(iris2)
# There are 56 observations and 3 variables

# Question 4
iris3 <- arrange(iris2, desc(Sepal.Length))
print(head(iris3))

# Question 5
iris4 <- mutate(iris3, Sepal.Area=Sepal.Length*Sepal.Width)
str(iris4)
# There are 56 observations and 4 variables

# Question 6
iris5 <- summarize(iris4, meanSepalLength=mean(Sepal.Length), meanSepalWidth=mean(Sepal.Width), sampleSize=n())
print(iris5)

# Question 7
iris6 <- iris4 |>
    group_by(Species) |>
    summarize(meanSepalLength=mean(Sepal.Length), meanSepalWidth=mean(Sepal.Width), sampleSize=n())
print(iris6)

# Question 8
irisFinal <- iris |>
    filter(Species != "setosa" & Sepal.Length>6 & Sepal.Width>2.5) |>
    select(Species, Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width) |>
    arrange(desc(Sepal.Length)) |>
    mutate(Sepal.Area=Sepal.Length*Sepal.Width) |>
    group_by(Species) |>
    summarize(meanSepalLength=mean(Sepal.Length), meanSepalWidth=mean(Sepal.Width), sampleSize=n())
print(irisFinal)

# Question 9
longIris <- iris |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols=c(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, Petal.Length, Petal.Width),
        names_to="Measure", values_to="Value"
    )
print(head(longIris))
```
